summary.text: IP riders can lower some hospital costs, but premiums are paid in cash and rise as you age.

details.heading: What riders cover
details.body: They cover part of your IP deductible and co-insurance. You still pay at least 5% of the claimable amount. Some riders also cover extra treatments.

details.heading: What to consider
details.body: Consider whether paying more premiums is worth lowering your co-payment. Also compare the value of any extra treatment and service coverage.

details.heading: Paying for a rider
details.body: Rider premiums must be paid in cash. Premiums increase as you age, so consider whether you can afford them in the long run.

example_phrasings: What are IP riders and should I consider getting one?

quotes.text: IP riders are optional products designed to cover part of the deductible and co-insurance of your Integrated Shield Plan (IP).
